name: Vespera Mercy Blade
passives: Radiant Edict — Vespera's Mastery: Vespera's Radiant Edict: a solo vow scar that grows when the Titan uses ordered sigil zones to control enemies instead of relying on allies. Counterplay remains: deny favored terrain, force reaction bait, drain Momentum or Divinity.
lore: Vespera Mercy Blade is a colossal Empyrean artillery from The Radiant Hierarchies. Humans later copied fragments of this being into myth, ritual, monster lore, and sacred art, but the Titan is the older source: Empyrean artillery office: far-sight strike, horizon pressure, prophetic range; Thrones: living judgement seats, authority embodied.
personality: Ancient, immense, purposeful, and bound to the survival philosophy of its Realm.
visualDescription: Full-body living myth-source Titan, not a costume: Vespera Mercy Blade shows white-gold radiance, many-eye halos, glass armor, feathered and non-feathered wing geometries, bell-metal joints, choral vibration lines, living scroll seals, stair-ladders of light, cathedral vault anatomy, ophanim wheels, seraph fire, cherub guardian masks.. Role silhouette must read as Artillery. Materials include white gold, opal glass, bell bronze, pearl bone, blue-white holy fire, ivory scroll vellum, silver feather. The design must feel older than human mythology and avoid robot angel, spaceship armor, generic church costume, literal cathedral body, block tower silhouette, neon sci-fi halo.
developmentStatus: Combat kit, named gear, leveling hooks, and balance pass complete; artwork pending.

abilityDetails.name: Vespera Longshot Strike
abilityDetails.effect: Deal Celestial damage at range 5; gain 8 Momentum, or 12 if used from ordered terrain or into the Titan's marked target.
abilityDetails.counterplay: Line-of-sight denial, evasion, armor, or forcing low-value targets.

abilityDetails.name: Axis Zone Bombardment
abilityDetails.effect: Apply ranged area damage and objective-zone denial; also builds 10 Edict Charge when it changes enemy intent or breaks an objective action.
abilityDetails.scaling: 70% attack plus role utility scaling from energy
abilityDetails.counterplay: Interrupt before resolution, spread enemy ranks, or bait the cooldown.

abilityDetails.name: Vespera Mercy Blade: Horizon Cataclysm
abilityDetails.effect: Spend stored Edict Charge to create a two-round battlefield rule around ordered terrain; enemies receive a readable counter-window before the strongest effect lands.
abilityDetails.scaling: 140% attack; utility duration +1 at mastery tier 4
abilityDetails.counterplay: Move out of the rule zone, drain Momentum, or trigger the exposed recovery turn.

abilityDetails.name: Divine Ascension — Axis Celestial Unbound
abilityDetails.effect: Enter Ascendant stance for 2 rounds: +15% damage, +12 mitigation, empowered Edict Charge, and one mythic reaction override. Ends with a one-round recovery risk.
abilityDetails.scaling: Does not stack with external ultimate buffs
abilityDetails.counterplay: Survive the window, deny objectives during recovery, or force defensive reaction spending.

equipmentDetails.name: Empyrean Axis Implement
equipmentDetails.effect: +5 attack. Empowered basics against vulnerable enemies generate +4 Momentum but cannot trigger more than once per round.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: No extra action generation; damage bonus capped against bosses.

equipmentDetails.name: Vespera Mercy Blade Realmplate
equipmentDetails.effect: +1 armor and +1 resistance. First preventable hazard hit each battle is reduced by 25% if the Titan used a reaction last round.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Hazard reduction does not prevent scripted boss mechanics.

equipmentDetails.name: Vespera Edict Charge Core
equipmentDetails.effect: Edict Charge cap +20. At 80+ Edict Charge, the next Technique gains a role-specific rider, then drains 30 Edict Charge.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: One empowered Technique per two rounds; cannot chain with Ascension opener.

leveling.powerFormula: hp + attack*6 + range*5 + energy*7 + speed*6 + armor*2 + resistance*2 + critChance

balanceNotes.intendedDifficulty: Tuned for harder solo encounters: every Titan can win alone, but mistakes against counters starve Momentum/Divinity.
balanceNotes.primaryRole: project damage into crowds and objective zones
